The activity follows a pattern not covered by the bank's documented typologies: Device profile D2c2006f554c8, never seen on this account before 2016-11-15, made 2 online purchase(s) here; 19 other cards began using the same profile within 30 days, and 100% of its uses in that window were behind an anonymous proxy. The same activity links to 19 other card(s) through a shared device profile, including C01289-K1, C01996-K2, C02910-K1, C02975-K1, C03676-K2, C04108-K2. The first suspicious transaction was 3460634 on 2016-11-15 20:30. Policy section 3a requires this filing because the activity connects to a shared device profile; the pattern is coordinated and undocumented (R9). The card has been recommended for blocking and connected cards for monitoring. All transaction identifiers cited above exist in the bank's records and can be re-queried.
